scenes: How does a heatwave put salt in the fields?
Heat and drought lower rivers and canals. | With less fresh water pushing out, the sea pushes in.
In Viet Nam’s Mekong Delta in February 2024, a long heatwave let sea water push inland. | Farmers who pumped the salty water onto their rice lost up to half their crop.
Store fresh water before the dry heat comes.
